verdict.rationale: The pack contains no affirmative documentation that Luma can extend a clip or regenerate a single segment without re-rendering. The only direct mention is the FAQ question "Can I extend a prior video?" in luma-docs-37, and a question is not affirmative support. Modify Video V2 restyles whole existing footage and Multi-Keyframe directs a clip as it is generated; these are adjacent features, not segment-level regeneration or clip extension.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
